ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Judgment and Decision Making. Judgments and decisions are often made under uncertainty: Who should I marry? What school should I go to? Is this a good price for dishwasher detergent? This seminar will investigate the heuristics that commonly underlie judgments under uncertainty, the errors and biases these heuristics produce, and what these mechanisms suggest about the processes of decision making. Special attention will be given to social psychological aspects of intuitive judgment. Open to graduate students.
